title: SUM and AVG of a group or window frame of one `-0.0` give `-0.0`
verdict: -0.0 for a one-row group or frame holding -0.0; +0.0 otherwise
description: A grouped `sum`/`mean` (in memory and streaming) and an in-memory `.over` window of a group whose only value is `-0.0` return `-0.0`: a one-row group's sum is its value. Ungrouped `sum`/`mean`, `cum_sum`, a streaming `.over`, and every group of two `-0.0` give `+0.0`, as the accumulator starts at `+0.0`.
sverify's translation reads both through `one_zero` (`shims.one_zero`, `Shim.one_zero`): the grouped `float_sum`/`float_avg` already did; the window SUM and AVG do since #2587.
reference: The reference's SUM is D25's exact sum rounded once (`floatSumCR`), so a sum of only -0.0 is the exact zero, +0.0; AVG divides it, +0.0 (ruling 285, F285). `agg.fsum` reads no `zero_sign`.

evidence.sql: SUM and AVG of a double column holding {-0.0} and {-0.0, -0.0}: ungrouped, GROUP BY, a PARTITION window and a running window
evidence.observed: grouped and in-memory window, one -0.0: -0.0; ungrouped, cum_sum, streaming window, two -0.0: +0.0

provenance.notes: polars py-2.1.0 Python package, macOS arm64, Python 3.12.
